# Vendored dependency provenance

This directory carries an exact copy of the `js` account module of the official
Proton Drive SDK monorepo. Upstream publishes `@protontech/drive-sdk` on npm but
does not publish its account module; it is consumed upstream as the local
monorepo package `proton-drive-sdk-account` (see `docs/AUTH-INTEGRATION.md`).

Package: `proton-drive-sdk-account`
Upstream repository: <https://github.com/ProtonDriveApps/sdk>
Upstream path: `incubating/account/js`
Pinned upstream commit: `e6a661f55b8d7c406de87747b6796891587681e6` (tag `js/v0.21.0`,
the same SDK version this project pins in `package.json`)
Upstream license: MIT (`UPSTREAM-LICENSE.md`)
Upstream package artifact preserved unchanged: `src/provenance-package.json`

Files copied unchanged:

- `src/index.ts`, `src/accountAddress.ts`, `src/accountApi.ts`, `src/addresses.ts`
- `src/apiClient.ts`, `src/auth.ts`, `src/authWeb.ts`, `src/logger.ts`
- `src/sessionCredentials.ts`, `src/sleep.ts`, `src/srp.ts`, `src/telemetryPreference.ts`
- `src/api-auth-types.ts`, `src/api-core-types.ts` (generated by upstream's
  `generate-types` script from upstream's OpenAPI documents)
- `src/apiRequirements.ts` and `src/messageEmitter.ts` come from `cli/src/api/`
  at the same commit; the CLI's `driveRequirementHook.ts` wrapper is reimplemented
  in `daemon/src/sdk-client.ts` with the same semantics and arguments.

Nothing in this directory is modified relative to upstream, except:

- `src/provenance-package.json` is upstream's own `package.json` renamed so the
  npm project root is not confused by a nested manifest.

The account module imports `ky` and `@protontech/crypto`; both are pinned exact
in the root `package.json`. `@protontech/crypto` 2.0.0 requires the
`patches/@protontech/crypto@2.0.0.patch` openpgp-runtime fix from the upstream
monorepo; it applies to the installed dependency after `npm install` (npm
package manager support for `patchedDependencies` requires npm ≥ 12, so
`scripts/patch-crypto.sh` applies it under npm, while Bun applies it natively).
